captions.detailed: A twin-globe commercial candy dispenser with two transparent spherical bowls mounted side-by-side on cylindrical grey metal support columns, all resting on a dark rectangular base. Each clear globe is topped with a grey hinged lid equipped with a small black knob, and has a black dispensing dial on its front. A central grey collection cup is positioned between the two support columns to receive dispensed candy.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a dual-globe candy dispenser featuring a rectangular base, two vertical support columns, two transparent spherical globes with hinged lids, and a central collection cup. Ensure both dispensing knobs and the top lids are defined as separate articulated parts with appropriate rotational joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a rectangular base using a Box primitive, then adds two Cylinder primitives as vertical columns. Spherical globes are created via boolean operations on spheres and cylinders to form hollow transparent shells. The lids, dispensing dials, and central collection cup are constructed using combined Cylinder and Box primitives, positioned with translation transforms, and integrated into an ArticulatedObject with revolute and continuous joints.
